label: Bible Study
prompt: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and _____ about many things:
verse: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
note: Martha's busy kitchen — Jesus says only one thing is needful, and Mary had chosen it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his _____ tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.
verse: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.
note: Solomon's golden age: everyone safe under his own vine and fig tree, from Dan to Beer-sheba.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that _____, and the tables of the covenant;
verse: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
note: Inside the ark of the covenant: the tables, a pot of manna, and Aaron's rod that budded (Numbers 17:8).

label: Deep Water
prompt: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very _____ song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
verse: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
note: Ezekiel's audience enjoyed his preaching like a concert — and went home without doing anything.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But there is a God in heaven that _____ secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;
verse: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;
note: Before Nebuchadnezzar, Daniel took no credit at all: 'there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets.'
